strategy: SOL — часовой диапазон, SHORT и LONG 1:1 v14

method.execution: Actual v14 Pine source in PineTS 0.12.0, observation plots only
method.entry: v14 retest touch; skip new-extreme historical bar
method.swingPair: At least one candle between central P1/P2 bars; reject adjacent pair and restart; trail P1 until P2
method.longReversal: After an unbroken SHORT range, retain its low as floor 0 for LONG; preserve first upper pivot, skip adjacent low, wait for a deeper nonadjacent P2
method.confirmingBarBreakout: Retain P3 extreme on the bar confirming P2; no retroactive entry on that bar
method.fiboReanchor: After a separate partial retest without entry and a new P3 extreme, use Fibo P2 to P3: S=P2-0.25*(P3-P2); retain initial anchors without partial retest; freeze on entry
method.exits: Check from the next M5 after entry; simultaneous TP/SL is ambiguous
method.referenceRollover: Unresolved trade is recorded separately, without a fabricated exit
method.stopOffset: Default 0.03 USDT beyond the Fibo line; entry remains the unbuffered Fibo midpoint
method.rUnits: 1R is actual buffered stop risk; target R is actual reward/risk, not fixed +1; no compounding
